name: Student Guild Campus Cupboard
provider: Griffith University Gold Coast Student Guild
summary: Free groceries, pantry staples and fresh fruit and veg for Gold Coast campus students twice a week.
how: Bring your own bag and student card, next to The Uni Store (G07).
catches: Every Monday and Thursday from 2pm, until it runs out.
